start: Admin app as the owner, Settings, card "Free MettleUp Plus for your members", the switch at its default (on)

user_sees: The box "Lock the paid features when a member’s plan ends" ticked
must_not: The box unticked when the gym never changed it

user_sees: "Saved. Members keep the paid features after their plan ends."
A line with who changed it and when
must_not: The save lost after a refresh

start: Admin app as the owner, the card open, no internet

steps.action: Untick and press "Save" with no internet
user_sees: An error line; the box shows the saved value again
must_not: "Saved." for a save that did not reach the server

start: Admin app as the owner, the switch was turned off yesterday

steps.action: Tick the box again and save
user_sees: "Saved. Paid features lock 7 days after a member’s plan ends."
must_not: The old off value shown after a refresh

start: Admin app as the owner, the card

user_sees: Only the paid extras are named (watch app, older charts, suggested weights, calculators, more own exercises)
must_not: Any word that the member's workouts or history get locked

start: Admin app as front desk, Settings, the Plus card

user_sees: "On: paid features lock 7 days after a member’s plan ends."
must_not: A box the desk can change

start: An older admin app that still shows a Save to the desk

user_sees: A word that only the owner can change this
must_not: The switch changed by the desk

start: Admin app as front desk, the owner just turned the switch off

user_sees: "Off: members keep the paid features after their plan ends."

start: Member app, in a gym with the switch on, plan ended 8 days ago

steps.action: Open the app and try a paid extra (for example older charts)
user_sees: The paid extra locked with a word to renew
Own workouts, history, routines and records all there
must_not: The extra still free when the gym's switch is on

start: Member app, in a gym with the switch off, plan ended 8 days ago
Member app of a member who left the gym

steps.action: The app asks the gym's switch
user_sees: The app treats the member as no longer in that gym; the gym's switch is not used
must_not: The member who left treated as in the gym

start: Member app, extras locked after the plan ended

steps.action: The member renews at the desk
must_not: Still locked after the renewal shows in the app

steps.action: The owner turns the switch off
user_sees: The extras unlocked at the next check
must_not: Still locked with the switch off
Any own data hidden by the lock
